compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as building AI systems and selling applied AI engineering work, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency. It also contains many company-specific results and technical claims that are not supported by the company sources; decide whether this case study and the offer it promotes should remain before editing it.
